Slop Watermark · free, in your browser

Add your logo to many photos at once

Brand a whole shoot, a product catalogue or a set of listing photos with your logo in the same place on every picture. Photographers, shops and estate agents do it in minutes, on their own computer.

Add a logo to photos

How to do it

  1. Drop your photos on the page, or choose Open pictures…. Up to 500 at a time.
  2. Set What to stamp to Your logo, then Upload logo… (PNG, SVG, JPEG or WebP; a PNG or SVG with transparency looks best).
  3. Pick one of the nine positions, then set the Logo size, Opacity and Margin from the edge. The preview shows the first photo.
  4. Press Apply to all, then Download all (ZIP), or download the pictures one by one.

The logo is sized as a share of each picture's shorter side, so it looks the same on a small and a large photo. Portrait, landscape, square and panorama pictures can each get their own position, size and opacity if one setting does not suit them all.

Your files stay on this device: Slop Watermark runs in your browser, with no upload, no account and no watermark.

Questions

Will my photos lose quality or size?

They keep their pixel size (very large ones are capped at 8000 pixels on the long side). JPEG and WebP are saved as JPEG and WebP at high quality; other types are saved as PNG.

Does it remember my logo?

Yes. The setup is saved in this browser, with the logo too when the file is under 500 KB.

Are my photos uploaded?

No. The pictures and the logo are read and stamped in your browser, and nothing is sent anywhere.

Can I use text instead of a logo?

Yes. Set What to stamp to Text, type your name or © line, and choose the font, colour and a soft shadow.
